notes: Puy de Dôme by the closed toll road (route à péage), the climb of the app profile ('ab der Schranke rund vier Kilometer'): cols-cyclisme gives 4.00 km, +478 m, 11.95 %, from the old toll barrier at the Panoramique des Dômes (~925-934 m) to 1412 m. The toll road leaves the D68 'Route du Puy de Dôme' (the road from Royat/La Font de l'Arbre to the Col de Ceyssat; the Royat - Col de Ceyssat climb shares the road up to the Panoramique station) on the east side of the cone and spirals 1.25 times round it beside the rack railway; the Col de Ceyssat itself (1078 m) is further along the D68 on the south-west side and is not on this route. km 0 = start of the restricted road (Overture class changes from unclassified to service, 0.48 km west of the D68 junction at the base station; DEM 930 m, app startElevationM 935). Finish = end of the road on the summit plateau (DEM 1415 m). Routed length 4.05 km vs app 4.0 km; DEM per-km grades 11.0-12.5 % match the app's 11.5/12.0/12.5/12.0. The 2023 Tour approached from Clermont-Ferrand via the D68 and then took this road. The road has no real hairpins; waypoints every 0.5 km keep the path on the spiral (it is the only road on the cone).
